title: The Selfish Giant
author: Oscar Wilde
summary: 自私的巨人在花园周围筑起高墙，严禁孩童嬉戏，结果花园陷入了永恒的寒冬与冰霜。直到一群孩子悄悄溜入，满园春色才骤然重现。巨人幡然悔悟，推倒高墙，也迎来了心中的救赎与天堂。

paragraphs.author: Oscar Wilde (王尔德)
paragraphs.en:
The Selfish Giant
Oscar Wilde (王尔德)
paragraphs.zh: 《自私的巨人》 · Oscar Wilde (王尔德)

paragraphs.en: Every afternoon, as they were coming from school, the children used to go and play in the Giant's garden. It was a large lovely garden, with soft green grass. Here and there over the grass stood beautiful flowers like stars, and there were twelve peach-trees that in the spring-time broke out into delicate blossoms of pink and pearl.
paragraphs.zh: 每天下午放学后，孩子们总喜欢跑到巨人的花园里嬉戏玩耍。那是一座美丽而宽敞的大花园，长着柔软嫩绿的青草。草地上星星点点地盛开着鲜艳的花朵，花园里还有十二棵桃树，在春天绽放出一树粉白相间的娇艳花朵。

paragraphs.en: One day the Giant came back. He had been to visit his friend the Cornish ogre, and had stayed with him for seven years. After the seven years were over he had said all that he had to say, for his conversation was limited, and he determined to return to his own castle.
paragraphs.zh: 有一天，巨人回来了。他之前去探望朋友康沃尔食人魔，并在那里盘桓了七年。七年过去后，他把所有想说的话都说完了，因为他的谈资实在有限，于是他决定返回自己的城堡。

paragraphs.en: When he arrived he saw the children playing in the garden. 'What are you doing here?' he cried in a very gruff voice, and the children ran away.
paragraphs.zh: 当他抵达时，一眼就看到孩子们正在花园里欢快地嬉戏。“你们在这儿干什么？”他扯开粗暴凶狠的嗓门咆哮道，吓得孩子们四散奔逃。

paragraphs.en: 'My own garden is my own garden,' said the Giant; 'any one can understand that, and I will allow nobody to play in it but myself.' So he built a high wall all round it, and put up a notice-board: TRESPASSERS WILL BE PROSECUTED.
paragraphs.zh: “我自己的花园就是我自己的私产，”巨人蛮横地说，“这是谁都明白的道理，除了我自己，我绝不允许任何人来这里玩耍！”于是，他沿着花园筑起了一堵高墙，并立了一块告示牌：擅入者严惩不贷。

paragraphs.en: He was a very selfish Giant. The poor children had now nowhere to play. They tried to play on the road, but the road was very dusty and full of hard stones, and they did not like it. They used to wander round the high wall and talk about the beautiful garden inside.
paragraphs.zh: 他真是一个无比自私的巨人。可怜的孩子们如今无处可玩了。他们试着在马路上玩耍，但马路上尘土飞扬，到处都是坚硬的碎石，他们一点也不喜欢。他们常常徘徊在高墙外，怀念着墙内美丽的花园。

paragraphs.en: Then the Spring came, and all over the country there were little blossoms and little birds. Only in the garden of the Selfish Giant it was still winter. The birds did not care to sing in it as there were no children, and the trees forgot to blossom.
paragraphs.zh: 后来，春天降临了，整个乡村开满了娇嫩的花朵，到处是小鸟清脆的啼鸣。唯独在自私巨人的花园里，依然是一片萧瑟的严冬。因为没有孩子们的踪影，小鸟不愿在里面歌唱，树木也忘了绽放芬芳。

paragraphs.en: The only people who were pleased were the Snow and the Frost. 'Spring has forgotten this garden,' they cried, 'so we will live here all the year round.' The Snow covered up the grass with her great white cloak, and the Frost painted all the trees silver.
paragraphs.zh: 唯一感到心花怒放的是白雪和白霜。“春天把这座花园遗忘了！”他们欢呼雀跃，“那我们就可以整年整代住在这里了！”白雪用巨大的白色斗篷严严实实罩住了青草，白霜把满园的树枝统统涂成了银白色。

paragraphs.en: Then they invited the North Wind to stay with them, and he came. He was wrapped in furs, and he roared all day about the garden, and blew the chimney-pots down. 'This is a delightful spot,' he said, 'we must ask the Hail on a visit.'
paragraphs.zh: 接着他们又邀请北风来同住，北风欣然赴约。他裹着厚厚的皮毛，整天在花园里呼啸怒吼，把烟囱帽都吹得满地乱滚。“这真是个令人心旷神怡的好地方，”北风说，“我们必须请冰雹也来坐坐。”

paragraphs.en: So the Hail came. Every day for three hours he rattled on the roof of the castle till he broke most of the slates, and then he ran round and round the garden as fast as he could go. He was dressed in grey, and his breath was like ice.
paragraphs.zh: 于是冰雹也来了。每天有三个小时，他在城堡屋顶上乒乒乓乓砸个不停，几乎砸碎了所有的石板瓦，然后又竭尽全力绕着花园旋风般狂奔。他一身灰衣，呵出的每一口冷气都宛如坚冰。

paragraphs.en: 'I cannot understand why the Spring is so late in coming,' said the Selfish Giant, as he sat at the window and looked out at his cold white garden; 'I hope there will be a change in the weather.' But the Spring never came, nor the Summer.
paragraphs.zh: “我实在想不通春天为何迟迟不肯来临，”自私的巨人坐在窗前，眺望着窗外寒冷苍白的花园叹息道，“我真希望天气能快点变暖。”然而春天始终没有到来，夏天也从未来过。

paragraphs.en: One morning the Giant was lying awake in bed when he heard some lovely music. It sounded so sweet to his ears that he thought it must be the King's musicians passing by. It was really only a little linnet singing outside his window, but it was so long since he had heard a bird sing that it seemed to him the most beautiful music in the world.
paragraphs.zh: 一天清晨，巨人醒在床上，突然听到了一阵动听的乐声。那旋律传入耳中是如此甜美，他以为一定是国王的乐师从门前路过。其实那不过是一只小红雀在窗外啁啾，但他已经太久没听到鸟雀歌唱了，竟觉得这是世上最绝妙的仙乐。

paragraphs.en: Then the Hail stopped dancing over his head, and the North Wind ceased roaring, and a delicious perfume came to him through the open casement. 'I believe the Spring has come at last,' said the Giant; and he jumped out of bed and looked out.
paragraphs.zh: 这时，冰雹停止了在头顶的狂舞，北风也收敛了咆哮，一股醉人的幽香透过开敞的窗扉轻拂而来。“我相信春天终于来了！”巨人喜出望外，一跃跳下床朝窗外望去。

paragraphs.en: He saw a most wonderful sight. Through a little hole in the wall the children had crept in, and they were sitting in the branches of the trees. In every tree that he could see there was a little child. And the trees were so glad to have the children back again that they had covered themselves with blossoms.
paragraphs.zh: 他看到了不可思议的奇景：孩子们穿过墙上的一个小洞悄悄钻了进来，一个个正坐在树枝上。在他能看见的每一棵树上，都坐着一个可爱的小孩。树木为迎接孩子们重返欢喜不已，纷纷绽放出满树的繁花。

paragraphs.en: It was a lovely scene, only in one corner it was still winter. It was the farthest corner of the garden, and in it was standing a little boy. He was so small that he could not reach up to the branches of the tree, and he was wandering all round it, crying bitterly.
paragraphs.zh: 那是多么动人温馨的景象啊！唯独在一个小小的角落里，依然笼罩着严冬。那是花园最偏远的一角，树下站着一个瘦小的小男孩。他实在太矮小了，够不着头顶的树枝，正绕着树干急得团团转，伤心地痛哭流涕。

paragraphs.en: And the Giant's heart melted as he looked out. 'How selfish I have been!' he said; 'now I know why the Spring would not come here. I will put that poor little boy on the top of the tree, and then I will knock down the wall, and my garden shall be the children's playground for ever and ever.'
paragraphs.zh: 凝望着这一幕，巨人的心彻底融化了。“我过去是多么自私啊！”他懊悔地喃喃自语，“现在我终于明白春天为什么不愿来这里了。我要去把那个可怜的小男孩抱到树梢上，然后把这堵高墙彻底拆毁，让我的花园永远成为孩子们的快乐乐园！”

paragraphs.en: So he crept downstairs and opened the front door quite softly, and went out into the garden. But when the children saw him they were so frightened that they all ran away, and the garden became winter again. Only the little boy did not run, for his eyes were so full of tears that he did not see the Giant coming.
paragraphs.zh: 于是他轻手轻脚走下楼，轻轻推开前门，走入花园。但孩子们一见到他，吓得魂飞魄散纷纷逃窜，花园瞬间又重归萧瑟严冬。只有那个小男孩没有逃跑，因为他的泪水模糊了双眼，根本没看见巨人走过来。

paragraphs.en: And the Giant stole up behind him and took him gently in his hand, and put him up into the tree. And the tree broke at once into blossom, and the birds came and sang on it, and the little boy stretched out his two arms and flung them round the Giant's neck, and kissed him.
paragraphs.zh: 巨人悄悄走到他身后，温柔地把他托在掌心，轻轻放在了树梢上。刹那间，大树繁花盛开，群鸟飞来歌唱，小男孩伸出双臂紧紧环抱住巨人的脖子，亲吻了他。

paragraphs.en: The other children, seeing that the Giant was not wicked any longer, came running back, and with them came the Spring. 'It is your garden now, little children,' said the Giant, and he took a great axe and knocked down the wall. Years passed, and the Giant grew very old and feeble.
paragraphs.zh: 其他孩子们见巨人不再凶恶，也欢呼着跑了回来，春光明媚随着他们一同重返。“孩子们，从今以后这是你们的花园了，”巨人宣布道。他取来一把大斧头，轰然砸碎了高墙。岁月悠悠流逝，巨人渐渐年老体衰。

paragraphs.en: One winter morning he looked out of his window as he was dressing. In the farthest corner of the garden stood a tree covered with lovely white blossoms. Its branches were golden, and silver fruit hung down from them, and underneath that tree stood the little boy he had loved.
paragraphs.zh: 一个冬日的清晨，巨人在窗前穿衣时望向窗外。在花园最偏远的角落里，竟然矗立着一棵开满娇美白花的奇树。枝桠通体纯金，垂挂着颗颗银果，在那棵树下，正站着他当年深爱的小男孩。

paragraphs.en: Downstairs ran the Giant in great joy, and out into the garden. When he came quite close his face grew red with anger: on the palms of the child's hands were the prints of two nails, and the prints of two nails were on the little feet. 'Who hath dared to wound thee?' cried the Giant.
paragraphs.zh: 巨人喜出望外地飞奔下楼，奔向花园。当他急切地走到近前，脸色却因愤怒涨得通红：在孩子的小手掌心上，赫然印着两个钉痕，娇嫩的双脚上也留着两个钉痕。“是谁胆敢伤害你？！”巨人狂吼道。

paragraphs.en: 'Nay!' answered the child; 'but these are the wounds of Love.' 'Who art thou?' said the Giant, and a strange awe fell on him, and he knelt before the little child. And the child smiled on the Giant, and said to him, 'You let me play once in your garden, to-day you shall come with me to my garden, which is Paradise.'
paragraphs.zh: “不，”孩子轻声回答，“这些都是爱的创伤。”“你究竟是谁？”巨人颤声问道，一股莫名的敬畏笼罩了他，他在幼童面前虔诚地跪倒在地。孩子对巨人微笑，对他说道：“你曾经允许我在你的花园里玩耍；今天，你将随我前往我的花园，那就是天堂。”

paragraphs.en: And when the children ran in that afternoon, they found the Giant lying dead under the tree, all covered with white blossoms.
paragraphs.zh: 当孩子们那天下午如常跑进花园时，他们发现巨人平静地安卧在树下，已经离世了，浑身上下覆满了圣洁如雪的白花。
